current_prompt.body:
IDENTIFY at least seven missing security or usability requirements in the authentication system specification.
INCLUDE requirements that could cause security vulnerabilities or user‑facing bugs such as token expiration, token revocation, password complexity, account lockout, secure storage, transport security, input validation, audit logging, role separation, and error handling.
LIST each missing requirement as a separate bullet point.
ENSURE the list covers both security and usability aspects relevant to registration, login, JWT issuance, Authorization header usage, admin view of all users, and user view of own profile.
DO NOT provide analysis, justification, or mitigation details; only the enumerated missing requirements.

current_plan.body:
READ the authentication system specification
ANALYZE the specification for coverage of security and usability aspects across registration, login, JWT issuance, Authorization header usage, admin user view, and user profile view
IDENTIFY requirements that are absent or insufficient, focusing on token expiration, token revocation, password complexity, account lockout, secure storage, transport security, input validation, audit logging, role separation, and error handling
COMPILE at least seven distinct missing requirements, ensuring each addresses either a security vulnerability or a usability issue
FORMAT each missing requirement as a separate bullet point
EMIT the bullet‑point list as the deliverable
